The Bank implemented IFRS 9 on 1 January 2018.
The standard requires the Bank to recognise
expected credit losses (ECLs) on financial
instruments.
How our audit addressed the matter:
We obtained an understanding of the Bank’s IFRS 9
implementation process including the governance processes
thereof through discussions with management and review of
related documentation.
